dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 20, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: June 20th**

The Detroit Tigers took down the Chicago White Sox 4-1, led by Dillon Dingler's 17th home run of the season. In the same game, Sean Newcomb turned in a strong relief performance with 3.0 scoreless innings and 4 strikeouts.

The Cincinnati Reds exploded for 10 runs against the New York Yankees, with multiple players contributing to the outburst. Sal Stewart had a 6-RBI night, while Will Warren struck out 8 in 5.2 innings.

The Toronto Blue Jays edged the Chicago Cubs 8-6, thanks in part to Daulton Varsho's 3-RBI night, including a home run. Colin Rea turned in 5.1 scoreless innings for the Blue Jays.

The San Diego Padres defeated the Texas Rangers 6-4, with Manny Machado hitting a 5-RBI home run. Walker Buehler pitched 5.1 strong innings for the Padres, striking out 7.

The Washington Nationals took down the Tampa Bay Rays 4-3, with Dylan Crews hitting his 13th home run of the season. Brad Lord pitched 3.0 scoreless innings for the Nationals.

The Miami Marlins beat the San Francisco Giants 6-3, led by Max Meyer's 7 strikeouts over 5.0 innings. Casey Schmitt had a 3-hit night for the Giants.

The Atlanta Braves edged the Milwaukee Brewers 4-3, with Ozzie Albies hitting 2 home runs. Chris Sale pitched 5.2 scoreless innings for the Braves.

The Cleveland Guardians dominated the Houston Astros 8-1, led by Travis Bazzana's 2-home run night. Joey Cantillo pitched 8.0 scoreless innings for the Guardians.

The Philadelphia Phillies crushed the New York Mets 15-3, with Kyle Schwarber hitting 3 home runs. Cristopher Sánchez pitched 6.0 scoreless innings for the Phillies.

The Colorado Rockies took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 2-1, with Paul Skenes pitching 6.0 strong innings. Spencer Horwitz hit a home run for the Pirates.

The Los Angeles Angels shut out the Athletics 7-0, led by Walbert Ureña's 5.0 scoreless innings. Denzer Guzman hit his 2nd home run of the season for the Angels.

The Baltimore Orioles edged the Los Angeles Dodgers 3-2, with Trevor Rogers pitching 7.0 scoreless innings. Shohei Ohtani hit a home run for the Dodgers.

The Boston Red Sox beat the Seattle Mariners 5-1, led by Connelly Early's 6.0 scoreless innings. Wilyer Abreu hit a home run for the Red Sox.
